title: Villa Serene | Real Joy
meta_description: Top Reasons to Book the Lovely Home: * Private Pool* Private IN-HOME gym - state of the art equipment - *Must be 18 years to utilize equipment* Less than a mile from the Beach - Gulf View Heights Access* Ping Pong Table* Large Backyard Space* Community
description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book the Lovely Home: * Private Pool* Private IN-HOME gym - state of the art equipment - *Must be 18 years to utilize equipment* Less than a mile from the Beach - Gulf View Heights Access* Ping Pong Table* Large Backyard Space* Community Pool, Grills, Covered Picnic Area, and Playground* Quiet Neighborhood, Catch and Release Lake, and Nature Trails* Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef- more info under Area Attractions below* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is not available to adults under age 25. No Exceptions. *Welcome to Villa Serene, your perfect escape for relaxation and luxury along 30A. This beautifully designed 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath retreat invites you into a world of comfort and style. From the moment you pass through the gated entrance and meander along tree-lined cobblestone streets, you’ll be enveloped in an atmosphere of peaceful charm.The main floor boasts a spacious master suite with a sumptuous king bed, a spa-inspired ensuite featuring a soaking tub, and a walk-in shower. Nearby, Guest Bedroom 1 offers a versatile modular sleeping sofa, ideal for extra guests or a bonus workspace. Upstairs, two additional guest rooms await: one with a king bed, a private balcony, and an ensuite bath with a shower/tub combo, and another with a queen bed and its own private ensuite. With accommodations for up to 8 guests, there’s plenty of space for family and friends to unwind.The gourmet kitchen is fully equipped to meet your every culinary need, whether you’re preparing a casual breakfast or an elegant dinner. Outside, your private oasis awaits. Take a dip in the sparkling pool, enjoy the spacious backyard perfect for outdoor games, or simply relax and soak up the sun. For those looking to stay active, the private in-home gym features state-of-the-art equipment to keep your fitness routine on track.Make your next vacation unforgettable at Villa Serene, where cherished memories are waiting to be made. Book your stay today and experience the best of 30A living!Forest Lakes neighborhood has an idyllic setting overlooking a peaceful lake with thousands of acres of state forest bordering the community. Completely secluded and quiet, it's hard to believe Highway 30A is just down the road and offers quick access to all the amenities you could desire in this South Santa Rosa Beach location. The recently renovated community pools offer a relaxing dip after a long day at the beach. Make memories on the fishable lake, that's catch and release, and there's also a lovely, covered picnic area with grills, as well as a playground for the kiddos. Blue Mountain Beach is just to the east, and the shops, entertainment, and dining venues of Gulf Place Town Center are a short drive to the west. Incredible white sand beaches are a few minutes down the road.*Please note this home is located within an HOA community. Guests are required to follow all community rules and regulations, carefully review the rental agreement in full, and observe all posted community rules in the home to ensure a smooth and enjoyable stay. There are 2 parking places available for this home and 2 parking placards that must be placed in vehicles, including any rented LSVs, when in the community. There is no street parking or overflow available for guest use.*Bed Setup:1st Floor:Master Bedroom: King BedGuest Bedroom 1: Modular Sleeper Sofa2nd Floor:Guest Bedroom 2: King BedGuest Bedroom 3: Queen BedArea Attractions:This is a fantastic location with Gulf Place Town Center only 1.5 miles to the West and Watercolor, Grayton Beach, Seaside, Seacrest, and Rosemary Beach just minutes away to the East. Biking is a great activity to enjoy as the scenic bike path meanders along 30A. Bike over to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery for some homemade scoops that will have your taste buds coming back! You'll have an array of dining options to choose from! 30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar white sand and emerald green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17-mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine, and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous, there are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here.The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet out from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
